import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,time
from collections import Counter
from datetime import UTC,datetime
from pathlib import Path
started=time.perf_counter()
metadata=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['docker','inspect','web-modelos-app-1'],text=True))[0]
for item in metadata['Config']['Env']:
 key,_,value=item.partition('=')
 if key in {'DJANGO_SECRET_KEY','SAFETY_ENCRYPTION_KEY'}:os.environ[key]=value
os.environ.setdefault('DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE','config.settings')
import django
django.setup()
from apps.safety.retained_log_origins import checked_capture
from apps.safety.rights import fingerprint
from scripts.inventory_retained_origins import inspect_origin
from scripts.scope_retained_redis_origin import read_origin
sources=[]
for evidence in ['logs-historicos-inventario0110.json','logs-historicos-nueva-captura0110.json']:
 sources.extend(json.loads((Path('docs/evidencias')/evidence).read_text())['origins'])
groups={};origins=[]
for source in sources:
 identity=inspect_origin(source['path'])
 if identity['sha256']!=source['sha256']:raise ValueError('Changed source')
 body=read_origin(source['path']);size=checked_capture(body,datetime.now(UTC));local=[]
 for declaration in source['declarations']:
  if body['captured_at']!=declaration['captured_at']:raise ValueError('Changed capture cutoff')
 for record in body['records']:
  for stream in ['stdout','stderr']:
   group=fingerprint('historical-stream-v1:'+record['container']+':'+stream)
   counts=Counter(fingerprint('historical-observation-v1:'+group+':'+line) for line in record[stream].splitlines(keepends=True))
   state=groups.setdefault(group,{'service':record['service'],'stream':stream,'copies':[],'maximum_occurrences':Counter(),'observed':0})
   if state['service']!=record['service']:raise ValueError('Conflicting container service')
   previous=state['maximum_occurrences'];overlap=sum((counts & previous).values())
   observations=sum(counts.values());exclusive=observations-overlap
   state['maximum_occurrences']=previous | counts;state['observed']+=observations
   state['copies'].append({'source_ciphertext_sha256':source['sha256'],'captured_at':body['captured_at'],'observations':observations,'equal_to_prior_observations':overlap,'additional_byte_observations':exclusive})
   local.append({'stream_reference':group,'service':record['service'],'stream':stream,'observations':observations,'overlap_with_previously_examined_copies':overlap,'additional_byte_observations':exclusive})
 if inspect_origin(source['path'])!=identity:raise ValueError('Source changed during comparison')
 origins.append({'ciphertext_sha256':source['sha256'],'captured_at':body['captured_at'],'stream_bytes':size,'stream_comparisons':local})
rows=[]
for group,state in groups.items():
 counts=state.pop('maximum_occurrences');union=sum(counts.values())
 rows.append({'stream_reference':group,**state,'distinct_full_line_fingerprints':len(counts),'maximum_occurrence_union':union,'repeated_byte_observations':state['observed']-union})
result={'schema':'historical-log-byte-overlap-diagnosis-v1','source_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'observed_at':datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),'sources':len(origins),'origins':origins,'stream_groups':rows,'observed_seconds':time.perf_counter()-started,'method':'Group by exact container and stream; full timestamped UTF8 line including terminator, HMAC with scoped domain. Multisets preserve repeated equal lines; occurrence maxima compare bytes only, not event identity. Sources processed in recorded inventory order, not inferred temporal order.','method_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'observations':sum(r['observed'] for r in rows),'maximum_occurrence_union':sum(r['maximum_occurrence_union'] for r in rows),'partial':True,'sources_preserved':True,'plaintext_files_written':False,'subject_association_verified':False,'phase_accepted':False,'pending':['byte_overlap_does_not_prove_event_identity_or_subject','unknown_or_unprojected_content_and_disclosure_review','other_host_mail_cache_backup_sources','retention_authority_and_independent_custody']}
Path('docs/evidencias/logs-historicos-solapamientos0110.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ['sources','observations','maximum_occurrence_union','observed_seconds','sources_preserved','partial']}))
